title: Figure 2.4(b): Genetic inheritance model
content: Pearl's corrected inheritance model. Only talent is transmitted across generations; each generation's luck affects only that generation's success and has no directed route to later generations.

variables.name: Success 0
variables.content: Success in generation 0, caused by that generation's displayed talent.

variables.name: Talent 1
variables.content: The genetic component inherited by generation 1.

variables.name: Luck 1
variables.content: The independent luck variation entering success in generation 1.

variables.name: Success 1
variables.content: Success in generation 1, caused by Talent 1 and Luck 1.

variables.name: Talent 2
variables.content: The genetic component inherited by generation 2.

variables.name: Luck 2
variables.content: The independent luck variation entering success in generation 2.

variables.name: Success 2
variables.content: Success in generation 2, caused by Talent 2 and Luck 2.
